high_level_description: The image shows a person standing indoors against a wall adorned with several skateboard decks. The skateboard decks are mounted vertically and feature artistic designs, including what appears to be a face on one of them. The person is wearing a loose-fitting, dark gray sweater over a white shirt. They have long, dark hair that falls past their shoulders and are accessorized with a gold necklace and a hoop earring. The individual is posing with one hand raised near their head, possibly adjusting their hair or ear.
